description: Keep the preview down to the files you still need, and close each tab like in a browser instead of aiming at a tiny ×. Double-click or middle-click a tab you have read; on a Mac trackpad a three-finger click works too. Control+W and a palette command close the active tab, because ⌘W closes the window. A × at the right of the preview header hides the panel when you are back to the chat.
